verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials to an agent. Enterprise RBAC/SSO/IAM controls and per-tool approval gates are related access controls, not agent credential issuance, so they earn no credit. The axis applies to an agent framework, so the absence of evidence makes this "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
